regions.name: hc
regions.why: HC subsystem above the stop: L5 tail + L5f, L4 finish + L4r, L0 root store + L0r; every pair is a request/response loop, so they share one tree

regions.name: rt
regions.why: stop + router below it: L2 vstop, L1 router + 4 L1f fronts + L1c collector, L3 weights; one tree

reschedule_why: every stacked leaf pair talks both ways (the 276-b rung each way + CTL rows / HP beats), so ANY region split is a cross-region loop; the single crossing is the stop boundary L0|L2 (HP beats + cw + rung up, CTL row + rung down), the narrowest boundary of the HC/router split
mut4_why: every gunit leaf is event-driven (valid-qualified beats / jobs, no free-running calendar from reset), so a 1-stage reset slip of u_l5 is invisible to random lockstep (measured: MUT 4 at +1 PASSED, witness lp_bench_mut4_1stage.log); +40 > warm 30 proves the region reset run reaches the child
